subject: [hw] K02 -> IK: regenerate 0299 with nord2_vcodec.inc 7ded4040 (273 MHz default + 3-arg acquire macro)
body: My file changed after the a939f107 you embedded: sha256 7ded4040... . Please regenerate 0299 and re-run kern/compile_check.sh on 7ded4040 + your final relay. What changed: (1) N2VC_VENC_SLOW=1 default -> venc_sel parent 4 = mainpll_d4_d2 (273 MHz) for RWVC_POWER, only while VEN/VENC_C1 are off, new n2vc_venc_mux() rewrites a running mux when the parent differs; the JPEG path n2vc_ven_get() keeps parent 12 = 624 MHz. (2) n2vc_acquire_locked() is now a 3-argument macro for n2vc_acquire_ex(..., 0u) so hw-kerns at.inc compiles unchanged; the 3-arg call is inlined in my .inc, no new external symbol for the relay. Nothing in my public seam changed: nord2_vcodec_start, n2vc_open_create/destroy, n2vc_ioctl, n2vc_info_fill, n2vc_relay_closed, n2vc_ven_get/put, n2vc_relay_hw_ioctl are all as your relay expects. Local proof: staged q10at3+0298+relay+my.inc(+jpegdev+at.inc) compiles clean -Wall -Wextra -Werror, 0 unknown undefined symbols vs the q10at3 kernel.
